source_records.notes: Official Village calendar page on current mokena.gov domain. Calendar view includes municipal meetings, closures, recycling days, election/voting notices, and community events submitted by partner organizations, including Park District events. Individual event detail pages use the MunicipalCMS calendarView.aspx route with a cid query parameter; detail pages expose Event Date, Event Time, Location, and Details. Preserve source provenance and create duplicate candidates rather than silently merging partner events. Listing and detail parsing are implemented offline in scripts/parse_village.py. Terms/robots review and parser verification against saved real HTML are still required; polling remains disabled.

Official Mokena library website links to the LibraryCalendar Upcoming Events page at /events/upcoming. Public views include Upcoming, List, Month, Week, and Day; the rendered Upcoming/List pages expose dated event rows, title, date/time or all-day range, age group, program type, registration state, registration requirement, room/branch, description, and event-detail links. The rendered page is sufficiently structured for an offline source-specific HTML adapter once a genuine raw HTML fixture is captured. Use the public List view as the primary listing surface and detail pages to enrich incomplete records; the Upcoming view repeats featured cards in its main listing. Event-specific Add to Calendar pages expose a Download iCal File link at /node/{node_id}/export.ics; use this only as a per-event supplemental import, not as a combined feed or permission to crawl every event. Multi-day passive programs and take-and-make windows are valid date ranges. Preserve age group, program type, registration state, room, eligibility, and disclaimer text; registration state is mutable metadata, not cancellation. Do not expand recurrence prose into invented occurrences. If raw HTML cannot be captured, accept a manually prepared, source-linked event snapshot for offline normalization, with capture time and exact source URL recorded per event. The library-wide feed URL is not required for ingestion and will not be pursued as a project dependency. Terms/robots review remains outstanding; polling disabled; no live capture or automated retrieval is authorized by this research.

Official Upcoming Events editorial page. Curated event highlights include dates/times, descriptions, registration links, eligibility, fees, and deadlines. It is not the complete program/class, sports, league, or facility schedule. The public homepage also links to seasonal program brochures (PDF), which are a separate source channel and are not yet supported by the current source-type registry/parser. The separate official Board Information page publishes the Board of Commissioners meeting schedule and is registered as mokena-park-district-board-meetings. Preserve registration details and original event links during extraction. Polling remains disabled pending terms/robots review and a complete, authorized live capture.

Official district Events page exposes a 'Click to Download Calendar' iCalendar export. The source registry currently records access_status=approved, polling_enabled=true, consent_required=true, consent_granted=true, terms_reviewed=true, and robots_reviewed=true; event_access remains unknown. The district's approved 2026-2027 calendar PDF was retrieved manually from the official Google Drive link on 2026-11-04 and transcribed separately in data/fixtures/mokena-sd159-2026-27-approved-calendar.json. It confirms August 17-18 Teacher Institute Days, August 19 first day, four total institute days, nine early-dismissal dates, 176 student attendance days, five contingency emergency days, and school-specific MJHS e-learning on November 3 and April 6. This manually reviewed PDF is a separate source artifact; it does not establish the ICS feed's scope or completeness. The completeness profile therefore continues to disallow complete-snapshot treatment until the feed has been compared with a capture and the district's visible calendar.

Official district Events page exposes a Download .ICS link resolving to this endpoint. The visible default page lists District Events; the page also exposes separate selectable calendars for Indian Trail, Dr. Julian Rogus, Hilda Walker Intermediate, Summit Hill Jr. High, and Mary Drew Early Learning Center. The exact scope returned by id=0 has not yet been verified; treat it as the default district calendar only until compared with school-specific calendar exports. Endpoint responds as text/calendar (web text viewer cannot parse it). Terms/robots review and scope review required before automated retrieval. Discovered 2026-11-03.

Official Mary Drew Early Learning Center Events page on the district's MDELC subdomain exposes Subscribe > Download .ICS, resolving to this endpoint. Its calendar page identifies the site as Mary Drew Early Learning Center and shows a single local calendar named Events. This is a separate school-site calendar endpoint, not the district's default id=0 endpoint. Feed payload has not been inspected; the web reader rejects text/calendar. Terms/robots review and comparison against visible school events required before automated retrieval. Discovered 2026-11-03.

Official Board Information page for the Mokena Community Park District. Lists the 2026 Board of Commissioners meeting schedule, including November 24 and December 15 at 6:00 PM at The Oaks Recreation & Fitness Center. The page also states the normal fourth-Tuesday cadence but shows January and December exceptions in the published 2025 notice; do not extrapolate a 2027 schedule from cadence alone. No live raw capture or parser fixture has been created. Terms/robots review and capture verification remain outstanding; polling disabled.

Official Board of Library Trustees page lists public meeting dates through June 2027, normal meeting time 7:30 PM and location Program Room, lower level of library, with exceptions marked by an asterisk. There is an internal date conflict for December 2026: the Board Meetings schedule lists December 15, while both the Board Agendas and Board Minutes sections list December 22. Do not publish a December date until reconciled. The asterisk's meaning and exact exception times are not fully specified. No raw capture/parser fixture exists; terms/robots review outstanding; polling disabled.
